messages:
Priya S: Quick topic: we need a one-page SI co-sell routing + handoff snippet that AEs can paste into playbooks. Focus is SI integrations + HW partners + marketplace leads.
Liam V: Agreed. Two main categories: marketplace-origin leads and SI-origin leads. They should follow slightly different ownership rules.
Priya S: Exactly. Marketplace-origin stays with Marketplace AE unless an SI has an active engagement on the account. SI-origin maps to the SI AE unless the account is explicitly reserved by Sales.
Carlos R: Proposed rule of thumb: SI owns account if theres an active SOW, open ticket backlog, or an MSA executed within last 12 months. Otherwise Marketplace/Sales.
Maya H: Add an exceptions flow: if both claim, open a 48h internal dispute window -> escalate to partnership-triage channel. If unresolved and ARR > $200k, escalate to GTM lead immediately.
Priya S: Required handoff checklist to include: 1) primary contacts + emails 2) CRM link + current ARR estimate 3) TOI summary (workloads, infra, latency/SLA requirements) 4) marketplace SKU & estimated monthly spend 5) any HW partner IDs/serials and warranty notes 6) compliance flags (VPC, KMS, data residency).
Liam V: Add finance fields: referral discount code, HW partner rebate %, and suggested Dedicated capacity margin if spend > $X. Helps Finance sign off early.
Carlos R: For CRM automation, I can add an MSA detection flag and populate "si_claims" tag. Simple pseudocode we can paste in playbook:
```
if account.has_recent_msa(12_months) or account.has_active_sow():
  owner = "SI-AE"
elif lead.source == "marketplace":
  owner = "Marketplace-AE"
else:
  owner = "Sales-RM"
```
Maya H: Joint comms checklist: if SI requests a co-announce we require: draft case study, approved logos, PR contact info, legal OK, and a 10-business-day review lead time. Any earlier requires exec approval.
Priya S: Also include playbook note: pricing conversations default to Sales RM unless SI has price delegation documented in MSA. If referral credits apply, include the referral code on quotes.
partners-bot: FYI: partner onboarding doc updated: https://redwood.example/partners/onboarding (link).
Liam V: Operational items: weekly triage meeting (30m) with rotating chair: SI AM + Marketplace rep + Partnership PM. Keep agenda: contested claims, top 5 pipeline motions, action owner updates.
Carlos R: Action list: Priya to draft one-pager; Liam to add finance/hw fields; Maya to create triage calendar + invite; Carlos to add MSA flag & crm mapping.
Priya S: Deadlines: draft by Tue EOD, review Wed sync, publish in partner playbook by end of week. I'll post the draft here for quick comments.
Maya H: I'll reach out to the HW partner ops leads to confirm any extra metadata they want on handoff (warranty, serial, on-site contact).
Priya S: Thanks team  will share first draft later today. :thumbsup:
